choice: Current issue: Linear's issueVcsBranchSearch on the branch, else a workspace titled exactly like an issue ID. Project: the current issue's project, else a project whose resource links point into the folder's GitHub origin repository (an active project wins over a finished one), else the project of an issue that has the branch's pull request attached.
context: A cmux workspace is a folder on a git branch; nothing in Linear points to local folders.
rejected: Extracting the issue ID from the branch with a regex and team keys (Linear already matches custom branch names); taking the current issue from the pull request (one PR can be attached to several issues); guessing the repository from the folder name (the helper is not sandboxed and reads `git remote get-url origin`); a new custom attribute in Linear for the repository (project Resources links already exist).
title: Resolve the workspace's current issue and project in a fixed order
